## 966f31e63b08

**Reproduced generator-contract defect.** The generator advertises exact controls
for dimensions, template kind, footprint count, and density, but its production
path draws all of these directly from a private RNG and never consumes the
corresponding `gen_ctx` axes. It also accepts unknown override keys.

Exact reproducer (`checks/audit/966f31e63b08/override-counterexample.json`):
for generator SHA-256
`792fa0cc28b8a876404a8f5522cb5bff7d58a90b2efef0bc410af3d794495676`,
seed 19, sample index 7, medium difficulty, requesting
`grid_h=15`, `grid_w=15`, `template_kind=cross`, `n_footprints=9`, and
`five_density=0.56` returned the exact same 10×13 grid as the no-override call.
Passing the unknown key `__audit_unknown_axis__=123` also returned that same
accepted grid. `self_check` returned no errors, so the failure is silent.

The independent battery reproduced four failing stages:

- `lint`: missing `RULE_HASH` plus dead/singleton axis warnings;
- `defect_lint`: texture-domain overlap, dead texture, and rule-source divergence;
- `override`: more than 32,000 exact/provenance findings, identical grids across
  density extremes, and unknown-key acceptance;
- `authority_sync`: active selected and canonical rule sources diverge in text,
  despite execution parity.

Evidence is in
`checks/audit/966f31e63b08-battery/checks/966f31e63b08_before_battery_summary.json`
and the stage logs beside it. Profile-floor and semantic-contract stages were
also advisory rather than green. This was an audit-only target; I did not modify
it. The real-rule smoke passed, so I am not alleging an output-oracle error from
this override reproducer.

## 966f31e63b08

**Reproduced defect — generated support omits a canonical shape family, and an advertised control is inert.**

I inspected the selected generator at SHA-256 `792fa0cc28b8a876404a8f5522cb5bff7d58a90b2efef0bc410af3d794495676`, rule hash `ce10d36072c7`, ran lint/override probes, and sampled 100 seeds in each of `easy`, `medium`, and `hard` at sample index 0. Across 300 draws, the detected template bounding boxes were 57×`2x2`, 53×`2x3`, 115×`3x3`, 59×`3x2`, and 16×`5x5`; no one-dimensional template appeared. Canonical inputs include a `1x4` template. The exact census and representative draws are in `checks/audit/966f31e63b08/compact_probe.json`.

The same compact probe requests `five_density=0.34` and `five_density=0.56` with seed 17, sample index 0, medium difficulty; the returned grids are byte-identical. The full override evidence likewise reports identical behavior across the tested sweep (`checks/audit/966f31e63b08/override/`). The target also lacks the declared rule pin and accepts/ignores controls beyond what the output can evidence.

This is not a claim that the Racket rule is wrong. It is a distribution/override-contract defect: the generator does not cover a canonical 1×4 family and cannot honor a named density request. No source was changed because this was an audit-only target.
